stem: 在资本市场中，哪一个红旗信号最能表明洗钱行为？

options.A: 一只低价证券突然受到投资者追捧,价格随之上涨.
options.B: 一位交易客户持有集中于某一特定新兴市场的证券投资组合.
options.C: 一家公司发现以电子方式交易的基金需求意外增加
options.D: 一只证券呈现出成交量和价格均持续下降的交易模式

stem_en: Which red flag is most relevant to money laundering through capital markets?

options_en.A: A low-priced security sees a sudden spike in investor demand with a rising price
options_en.B: A trading customer maintains a portfolio of securities concentrated in one specific emerging market
options_en.C: A firm sees an unexpected increase in demand for electronically traded funds
options_en.D: A security sees a transaction pattern of a steady decrease in both trading volume and prices
